veranderings.rede: As a conjunction 'totdat' is clearer for a Grade 5 reader than bare 'tot', which reads first as a preposition.
The block already opens with 'Toe'; a second 'toe' is repetitive, and 'uiteindelik' keeps the same sequence (after the long pursuit) more naturally.

veranderings.voor: Seuns het na die vee gekyk
veranderings.rede: 'Die vee oppas' is the natural Afrikaans for herding livestock; 'na iets kyk' in the sense of 'look after' leans on English.
